seoTitle: Data Subject Request Response Templates (GDPR Reply Letters)
metaDescription: Generate a controller reply to access, erasure, portability, rectification, restriction or objection requests, including refusal and extension versions.
intro: Writes the reply a company sends to a data subject request: fulfilled, partly refused, refused, identity check or extension.
why:
When a person exercises a GDPR right, the company must reply within a month and say clearly what it did. Writing a good reply each time is slow, and the wording for a refusal or an extension matters.

This tool builds a draft for six request types and five outcomes, with the article numbers and the complaint information that a refusal needs. Bracketed parts need your own details. It is a template, not legal advice.
howTo: Choose the request type and the outcome.
Fill in company, requester, date, contact and reason.
Copy the draft and replace the [brackets].
Send it within the deadline and keep a record.

faq.a: One month, extendable by two months for complex or numerous requests (Art. 12(3)). Use the Deadline Calculator.

faq.q: Do I need to check identity?
faq.a: Only if you have reasonable doubts (Art. 12(6)). Ask for the minimum needed.

faq.q: Which tool writes the request itself?
faq.a: The GDPR Erasure / Access Request Letter tool, which is for the person making the request.
